_about_en: English for the vision-pass discrepancy fields of CN112645853A that quote the patent in Chinese. output/translations.json is the verified index and is applied first, by longest match; it covers the compound names but not the surrounding prose, and substring substitution into free prose produces unreadable half-translated sentences (one index entry for the generic benzoate salt is itself a whole sentence, so the mangling is severe on this run). Each field listed here is therefore hand-authored as a whole English statement, using the verified index's English for every compound name so the wording stays identical to the gold. Written against the run's own input/CN112645853A-enriched-numbered.md, whose per-line EN gloss is the provenance for every field that quotes a numbered paragraph. Paragraph markers are kept exactly as printed because the stage parses them out to attach page crops. No Chinese characters are quoted anywhere: where the patent's own printed characters are the point of the finding, the finding is stated in English instead. The patent's self-contradictions are translated as they stand and are never quietly corrected: potassium hydroxide made up as an aqueous sodium hydroxide solution, a two-step yield quoted against a compound that is not the drawn starting material, and (RS) named in prose where no stereo bond is drawn.

marker_labels_en._about_en: The front page numbers its fields with WIPO INID codes rather than with paragraph markers, and two of those field labels are printed in Chinese. English keys for them, so that every marker in page-index.json is addressable in English. Without these two keys the stage drops both markers rather than failing, so the front-page address and agent fields would go unrecorded and the page-index would look complete.

entries.p01#0.text_says: The abstract's second step reads: the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. The reagent side ends in a benzoate salt plus base, or a benzoate salt plus an alkali metal alkoxide, either of which would leave the carboxylate as its salt, yet the product is named as the free acid.
entries.p01#1.text_says: The abstract says that the content of impurities is lowered and that the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised. No yield percentage, no purity figure, and no comparison baseline appears anywhere on this page. Any number for this patent must come from the description pages.
